title: Ms
incidentLocation: Emergency Department, Royal Victoria Hospital, Belfast
incidentSummary: I slipped on wet steps and fell on my outstretched right hand. The Emergency Department at the Royal Victoria Hospital X-rayed my wrist, said there was no fracture and that it was a sprain, and sent me home with no follow-up. The pain continued. Weeks later another scan showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed coursework and shifts at my café job.

events.what: Fell on outstretched right hand; Royal Victoria Hospital Emergency Department X-rayed the wrist, said sprain, sent home with no follow-up
Repeat imaging showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed; surgery planned

desiredOutcome: An explanation of why I had no MRI or follow-up X-ray, an apology, a learning review, and information on compensation
